license_evidence: Own probe, 2026-10-23: both CKAN action API paths connection-refused; real-browser homepage load failed (ERR_SOCKS_CONNECTION_FAILED) - no licence statement could be read directly.

Third-party (recorded as attribution, not a publisher instrument): the Data Landscapers Ghana maturity assessment (corpus.data-landscapers.io/maturity/countries/gha/, read 2026-10-23) states 'Government data was published for download on the Ghana Open Data Initiative portal (data.gov.gh) in 2026; no open licence is on record', notes the portal was rebuilt 2018-2019, and cites the World Bank eTransform completion report (2023-12-23 as dated in that corpus; retrieved via search 2026-10-23) that 315 datasets had been uploaded since 2020 with the count not growing for 3 years and the portal down at the time of writing.

If the portal becomes reachable, the per-dataset licence must be read from the publisher's own instrument (CKAN package_show) before any lead is probed further; per the standing class-C policy, a portal with no stated licence terms cannot carry a new lead.

measurements.third_party_content_attribution: Search-index + Data Landscapers evidence (2026-10-23): ~912 resources / 271 catalogues / 22 MDAs claimed on the homepage; visible datasets are dated static CSVs (2008 presidential election run-off results, regional fire outbreaks 2007-2012, defilement cases 2015-2017, airport departures 1997-2015); catalogue count static ~3 years; no open licence on record.
measurements.not_measured: No first-hand licence read, no dataset download, no per-dataset metadata: the portal never answered from this coordinator.

review: Access-failure coverage record, kept as 'investigating' because an unreachable portal is not a scientific rejection. The third-party evidence (static catalogue, no licence on record, dated snapshots rather than ongoing series) makes it unlikely that this portal can carry a task even when reachable, but that hypothesis is untested from the publisher's own pages and is recorded as such. Ghana's zero-coverage gap is documented with the exact failed probes so a future tick can re-probe in seconds.
next_action: One bounded re-probe from a reachable network (worker-side curl of https://data.gov.gh/api/3/action/package_list alongside the ZA DWS access test, or from the coordinator if routing changes): if the CKAN API answers, read package_show licence fields on 2-3 datasets and count recently-updated resources; if per-dataset open licences exist AND any ongoing dated series exists, open a real candidate; otherwise close Ghana under the class C standing policy with the licence absence as the decisive fact. Do not spend further ticks on browser retries from this coordinator - the failure is network-level, not rendering-level.
